title: Ghost Meter
description: An occupied apartment is billed for power it never received. MOTH offers payment for the original meter certificate.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The meter reports a deliberate disconnection, signed hours before the outage.

lore.title: Ghost Meter / Unsent message
lore.text: MOTH / unverified relay: An occupied apartment is billed for power it never received. MOTH offers payment for the original meter certificate. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Ghost Meter / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Ghost Meter: The meter reports a deliberate disconnection, signed hours before the outage. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Ghost Meter / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under ghost-meter: The meter reports a deliberate disconnection, signed hours before the outage. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: The meter reports a deliberate disconnection, signed hours before the outage.
